segments.text: Imagine a robot vacuum you build yourself, where every part is open and nothing phones home.
It's called Umwu, over 12,000 GitHub stars.
And flip the name upside down, it still reads Umwu.
A spinning lidar on top scans every wall, draws a map of your home.
and plans its own path. Inside a Raspberry Pi runs ROS2, the same software real
robots use. No cloud, it works locally and it's designed to plug straight into
Home Assistant. The body is 3D printed so you can fix it, hack it,
Honest part, it's not buildable yet,
but you can drive it in a simulator today.
Makers around the world are building it together.
